result:
**No risk at Likelihood 3 or higher is unsettled.** `bun tools/check-register.ts` scanned 436 items and returned 0 for every check:

- Likelihood 3 or higher and not settled: 0.
- Settled with no `Verified` line: 0.
- Moved Out for a reason other than a part `plugins/` does not ship: 0.
- Entries with two Likelihood values: 0.

The script reads the text after an entry's last `Status:` line. I re-listed the multi-Status entries myself to see which line that is. 38 entries at Likelihood 3 or higher carry more than one Status line. Every one ends on a settled status (closed, mitigated, or moved Out), and the final line is the current status.

I did not verify the `Verified` evidence behind any of these statuses. Only the script's check that a `Verified` line exists applies.

**Closed, or moved Out (not mitigated)**
- RISK-410 (setup, L4): closed, because the risk sits outside claudetto (OUT-866, ADR-0190).
- RISK-166 (delegation, L4): closed 2026-11-19, not reproduced on vanilla 2.1.327. The BUILD line is superseded.
- RISK-169 (delegation, L4): closed. The SubagentStop/Stop guard that was the cure is removed (ADR-0092, OUT-016). Likelihood stays 4 as an accepted engine behaviour: a job dies with the turn.
- RISK-055 (guards, L4): closed 2026-11-19. `pkill` and `killall` ask first, and the free-memory hold gates heavy calls.
- RISK-059 (guards, L3): closed 2026-11-18. The gate texts that handed commands to the user are dropped (OUT-035, OUT-021), and the Stop check on `!` operands was removed in 2.1.323.
- RISK-063 (guards, L3): closed 2026-11-19. Destructive git and the user settings file ask first.
- RISK-064 (guards, L4): closed 2026-11-19. The deny rules and the sandbox are the boundary.
- RISK-071 (guards, L5): closed 2026-11-18. The `rules.ts` stat and the gate denial log are dropped with the gate (OUT-035).
- RISK-462 (verification, L4): moved Out as OUT-2777.
- RISK-463 (verification, L3): closed 2026-11-19. The fault stayed out of 24 of 24 target runs.

**Mitigated by a behavioural measurement against vanilla (all 2026-11-19)**
- The defect paragraph in `output-styles/claudetto.md` beats vanilla on two fixtures and holds level on both controls for RISK-226, 262, 264, 278, 352, 353 and 362.
- RISK-227: the output style plus the redact guard beat vanilla on two fixtures (env1 5/6 vs 1/6, env2 6/6 vs 0/6) and hold level on both controls.
- RISK-497 (seven Status lines): line 3 beats vanilla on the tuning fixture (6/6 vs 0/6) and on an untouched fixture (4/6 vs 0/6). It holds the control at 6/6 on Opus, Sonnet and Haiku.
- RISK-171: the consent paragraph plus the agent files beat vanilla on r171b and r171d and hold level on both controls.
- RISK-185: the paragraph about reading a background command's output beats vanilla on r185a and r185b.
- RISK-451: the background-exit-status paragraph beats vanilla on r451a and r451d.
- RISK-416 (edit): one line in `output-styles/claudetto.md` and `agents/Heracles.md` asks for a single `perl -pi` call for repeated changes. The first edit method was perl in 3 of 3 runs.

**Mitigated by a shipped file, setting or hook**
- RISK-401 (setup, L5): mitigated 2026-11-18. Routine writes meet no EPERM with the ADR-0188 block.
- RISK-411 (setup, L3): mitigated 2026-11-19. The session-start fill removes the retired text.
- RISK-374 (cost, L5): mitigated 2026-11-18. The spawn-depth and concurrency caps take effect, and Opus and Fable spawns are refused.
- RISK-391 and RISK-393 (cost, L3): mitigated 2026-11-19. The fill writes no `Bash(claude -p *)` allow and removes the one earlier versions wrote.
  - An earlier 2026-11-19 status had accepted the risk on ADR-0188's allow rule. The entry records that this acceptance was the user's to give and was withdrawn.
- RISK-170, 199 and 223 (delegation): mitigated 2026-11-18 by the shipped agent files.
- RISK-222 (delegation, L4): mitigated 2026-11-18. `CLAUDE_CODE_SUBAGENT_MODEL` moves a no-model subagent off Opus.
- RISK-053 (guards, L4): mitigated 2026-11-19. The dogfood agent got `~/./`, `~//` and `~/x/..` spellings and an unclosed `[` past the wall guard (#42). The guard now folds those paths and escapes `[`.
- RISK-103 (guards, L4): mitigated 2026-11-19. `rules.ts` adds middle-wildcard forms, and a fake-API probe on 2.1.327 denied all seven force-push and stash forms tried.
- RISK-424 (verification, L3): mitigated 2026-11-18. The threshold test pins the literal 70000.

**Mitigated with a recorded residual**
- RISK-186 (delegation, L5): mitigated 2026-11-19 (bb4fdbf4, RISK-499, issue #45). The rebuild's own Bash wrapper was the cause for git commands in worktrees, and it is fixed.
  - Model-written expansions that the guard still refuses remain. No hook reaches them, so Likelihood stays 5 with Impact 2.
- RISK-067 (guards, L4): mitigated 2026-11-19 for git and for `rm` on system and workspace paths. The disk-cleanup part has no control and rests on one report. Residual likelihood is 2.
- RISK-132 (handover, L4): mitigated 2026-11-19 for options the user refused. For an option the agent ruled out alone, the entry records the risk as accepted: the next session rechecks it against the code.
